tests.name: Seed relationships, active loans, copy states and financial balances
Loan dates follow copy acquisition and member registration dates
Data fits the explicit LocalStorage quota budget
Historical physical copy loans never overlap
Register a member with unique email and card
Reject duplicate email without mutating saved state
Issue links member, physical copy and title
Duplicate issue of a physical copy is rejected atomically
Members with active loans cannot be deleted or archived
Suspended and expired members cannot borrow
Renewal extends due date and keeps history
Renewal limit blocks further extensions
Reservation holds a copy and prevents duplicate reservations
Return updates the copy and offers it to reservation queue
Another member cannot issue a reserved copy
Reservation holder can issue and fulfill reservation
Closed loans cannot be returned twice
Overdue return records one consistent fine
Partial payment, full payment, receipt, and overpayment protection
Damaged return never becomes available
Fine waiver requires a reason and keeps zero balance
Receive acquisition partially, then complete, without duplicate copies
New-title acquisition creates a catalog title and physical copies
Purchase order transitions create exactly one acquisition per line
Study room bookings reject overlaps and over-capacity groups
Cancel and edit bookings preserve availability rules
Event registration rejects duplicates and tracks attendance
Inventory adjustments produce movement history and prevent negative stock
Referenced category and author deletion is prevented
Bookmark and digital reading history persist
Subscription renewal updates expiry and associated expenditure
Expired reservations release copies before reassigning the queue
Shelf capacity prevents copy creation overflow
Active physical copy metadata can be edited without releasing it
Stale-tab revisions are detected before saving
SQL sample results are simulated and destructive SQL never changes data
Stored changes survive reinitialization
Quota failure rolls back the entire mutation
Simulated sign-in supports temporary and remembered sessions
Static entry and module pages use correct relative roots
Dashboard and reports produce data-driven markup
All schema forms and module row renderers build without exceptions
Reset preserves unrelated storage and clears only Folio preferences and sessions
Export artifacts are generated as CSV and real ZIP-based XLSX
